prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET for a Dreamerie spot-the-difference puzzle. Return ONE altered image with the EXACT SAME 4:5 framing, geometry, textured painted style and positions. Make exactly the five specified meaningful object edits below. Match this existing illustrator's brushwork, shading and palette. NO random new props, circular patches, tint spots, labels, arrows or answer markers. Keep absolutely everything else unchanged, including background, all edges, decorations and lighting. Do not redraw or reframe the scene. Coordinates are percentages from top-left and help identify objects, not visible boxes.
1. Repaint the snail body pale blue, preserving its spiral shell and leaf. Target near x26%, y62%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
2. Edit only this object so: The cottage's arched door became rectangular. Target near x55%, y41%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
3. Edit only this object so: The cottage chimney disappeared. Target near x63%, y33%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
4. Edit only this object so: The upper attic window lost its crossbar. Target near x54%, y35%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
5. Edit only this object so: The tiny downward thorn beside the lower dewdrop disappeared. Target near x63%, y62%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
review: Visually reviewed. Only the five declared object regions are composited over the original; labels describe actual generated changes. See edits for final accepted answers.

edits.label: The snail's yellow body turned pale blue.
The cottage's arched door became rectangular.
The upper attic window lost its crossbar.
The tiny downward thorn beside the lower dewdrop disappeared.
